parameters.query:
WITH i24 AS (
  SELECT max(completed_at) AS last_ok
  FROM scrape_logs
  WHERE status='ok' AND (metadata->>'source'='inmuebles24' OR metadata->>'source' IS NULL)
),
eb AS (
  SELECT max(completed_at) AS last_ok
  FROM scrape_logs
  WHERE status='ok' AND metadata->>'source'='easybroker'
),
errs AS (
  SELECT count(*) AS n
  FROM scrape_logs
  WHERE status IN ('error','auth_error') AND completed_at > now() - interval '1 hour'
)
SELECT
  i24.last_ok AS i24_last_ok,
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - i24.last_ok))/60 AS i24_minutes_since,
  eb.last_ok AS eb_last_ok,
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - eb.last_ok))/60 AS eb_minutes_since,
  errs.n AS recent_error_count,
  ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')::time BETWEEN time '08:45' AND time '20:45') AS i24_active_window
FROM i24, eb, errs;

WITH recent_failures AS (
  SELECT event_id, occurred_at,
         COALESCE(metadata->>'reason', event_type) AS reason
  FROM public.lead_routing_events
  WHERE event_type IN ('delivery_failed', 'unassigned_alerted')
    AND occurred_at > now() - interval '10 minutes'
  ORDER BY occurred_at
)
SELECT r.event_id, r.occurred_at,
       s.status, s.reason, s.entered_at, s.operational_owner, s.acknowledged, s.just_entered
FROM recent_failures r,
LATERAL public.report_routing_failure(r.reason, 'wf20:' || r.event_id, r.occurred_at) s;
